name: zcode-pipeline
description: Multi-agent development conveyor for ZCode: initializer -> briefer -> architect -> tech lead -> tech writer -> developer -> reviews (security/goal/code) -> QA -> manager -> summarizer; analysis track (analyst + /analyze), fast-track profile (/fast), coordinator skill, /init-project, /self-test and /pipeline-status.
